remarks:
Discover 27.12 acres of hardwood-covered recreational land with excellent deer-hunting potential along popular Route 5/Southwestern Boulevard in Irving, NY. Offering a desirable combination of accessibility, privacy, mature woods, and recreational opportunity, this property is well suited for the hunter, outdoor enthusiast, or buyer looking for a future country homesite.
A newer driveway entrance provides convenient vehicle access from the road and leads into an extensive network of ATV and walking trails that makes exploring the property easy. The trail system winds throughout the acreage, providing excellent access for hunting, property management, hiking, ATV riding, and reaching different areas of the woods.
Deer sign is abundant throughout the property, with the hardwood forest, varied terrain, and surrounding habitat creating attractive conditions for whitetail deer and other wildlife. The property's north-facing elevation adds character to the landscape while providing the secluded wooded setting many recreational buyers are looking for.
A small shed provides convenient storage for hunting gear, tools, an ATV, or property-maintenance equipment. With road frontage along Southwestern Boulevard, an established entrance, and potential for a residential building site, the property also offers an opportunity to create a cabin, recreational retreat, or future year-round home, subject to applicable approvals.
Whether your goal is to establish a private hunting property, enjoy four-season recreation, invest in Western New York land, or eventually build a home surrounded by hardwoods, this 27.12-acre property offers an appealing combination of location, access, wildlife habitat, and versatility in the Irving area.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Building lot on road frontage, GMO’s and Timber Convey, ATV Trails, excellent deer hunting. 6.5 miles to North Collins, 3.57 miles to Angola, 5.6 miles to Silver Creek.
